messages:
maya: Quick check — vendor (CloudWave) says they can hand off standby SKUs tonight, but we need to flip 8 A100 slots into the staging pool and lift quota. Also pinging for PR #1421 (terraform changes) to get a quick LGTM before we schedule.

liam: I looked at the quota dashboard — we currently have 6/8 free slots in the europe pool. vendor can supply 4 extra immediately, rest needs invoice clearance. fallback would be preemptible blend.

natalie: procurement here — confirmed w/ CloudWave: +4 tonight if we sign the short invoice addendum. I opened PO-8345, linking the doc: https://acme.proc/PO-8345. Finance needs approve by 20:00 UTC or they hold until tomorrow morning.

sophia: For the rollout, can we do a canary to avoid evicting interactive demos? Suggest route: 2 slots to canary, 2 to staging, rest standby. Also set autoscaler max to 5 for the staging ASG for the window.

maya: SGTM. Also PR #1421 needs a tiny var rename (staging_pool -> staging_pool_id) so the Terraform plan doesn't error. Leaving a comment on the PR now.

devex: I left a one-line suggestion on #1421 — add the feature flag to the module call:
```
module "pool" {
  source = "./modules/pool"
  staging_pool_id = var.staging_pool_id
  enable_quota_lift = true
}
```

liam: If procurement lands +4 tonight we can schedule the swap at 23:30 UTC. ops oncall to run the small smoke (simple inference run @ 256 tokens).

procurement-bot: Reservation created: CloudWave +4 A100s for tenant:redwood-staging. Reservation ID: RW-RES-2026-117.

maya: Thanks all — @natalie please confirm when finance signs. @liam @sophia can one of you approve the PR after the var rename? i'll queue the runbook. :thumbsup:

natalie: finance approved at 19:42 UTC, invoice signed. PO-8345 attached to reservation.

liam: Approved PR #1421. small note in changelog.

ops-bot: Quick ops checklist runbook created: https://runbooks.internal/overnight-sku-handoff — scheduled maintenance window 23:30-00:15 UTC. Will post results in #incidents if smoke fails.

maya: Perfect. I'll kick the job at 23:25 and run the quick smoke. If anyone sees the demo service degrade, ping me directly.

sophia: Roger. I'll monitor canary and rollback if 5xx spike > 1%.

ops-bot: Deploy scheduled by maya for 23:30 UTC (window id: win-2026-03-20-09).
